body.prose:
A holon keeps every state it has had, each version pointing back at the one before, so the root mount's versions are already the reader's history, and nothing else is needed to hold one. To look somewhere else is to give the root mount another argument: a new version of it. Back is the version before, and the browser's own back and forward walk the versions, translated by the interface; walking writes the old version again, so history only ever grows.

A press does not need catching from above. Every slot says where it is: its element carries the holons it reads as its location, and a link in prose carries the one it mentions. A press rises through the page from where it landed, past those locations, to whatever holds them and cares. The mount component cares, where it may write its mount: a press inside it gives the innermost location it passed, and the mount gives that instead, drawn again by the component the entry calls, the reader. The brief that was pressed never knows it was read; a mount that may not be written lets a press rise on.

Where one is looking is said above it by the search, the first of the reader's two mounts, given what the second draws. A way of looking is said by its parts, each a meaning, of this type, held by that, saying these words, grouped by what splits it best, each a chip let go with a press; a holon by what it is, each type a way to its kind, and what it is called. Typing searches the field from there: what says the words, as a part to narrow by; the types they name, to narrow to; the ways of grouping; and the holons that say them, those whose title says them first, each a place to go, or a part, what it holds or what points at it. Before anything is typed it offers what is near: the favorites, ways out of a holon, other ways to group. Each thing it offers is a press that says where it leads, and rises to the mount like any other: a place, a place drawn by a component, a way of looking, or what the mount offers. A way of looking the field does not hold yet is born in the home as the mount moves to it, and the one it already holds is looked through again.

The secondary press rises the same way, and the mount lays the same search where it landed, given the place pressed and the component it is drawn by, so what can be done there is found as anything is: to look there; to look there with each other component that takes it, for that one look; to set what that component takes and nothing gave it, as a list's cards, which the mount then offers; and to place it on the favorites, or take it off. The search is what the mount is offered as its search, and the favorites what it offers, so both are the reader's to change, as data.

```ts
holon The root : Mount {          // the reader's own, in the home
  component: ref(Reader)
  argument:  [ ref(Brief, saying "reader") ]   // narrowed in the search, and this is new
  offer: {
    search:    ref(Search)                      // what its menu is drawn by
    favorites: [ ref(Everything), ref(Brief, saying "reader") ]
    cards:     true                             // a list's setting, offered to all it draws
  }
}
```

*The author's, 2026-11-03: navigation needs a kind of history and is based on locations; the reader needs a way to see the actual location you are looking at and to be able to update it, for a face of it is not that helpful, and not by presets or raw text, but ontologically, naturally; the root holds the expression for what you are seeing, and changing it from the context menu's WYSIWYG is fine; the context menu has actual actions, made available by type matching; the history stack and the URL as an integration. Bubbling the session's proposal, which the author was open to; catching every press at the root was OpenLight's answer, not taken for granted. History as the root's versions the session's, as OpenLight's collation cited its predecessor. Programs, once they run, are where more of the menu's actions will come from; the URL is not yet written. The search the author's, the same evening: expressions are ontology, every part has meaning; the formula said at the top, visualized and editable, a smart search across expressions, briefs and holons, narrowing by type to build an intersection, a made expression found by its name; favorites the reader looks for; a list's cards set by right-clicking it; and the search one common component, the context menu a very similar thing, its input everything or already narrowed. A setting as an offer the author's correction of the session's mount settings. Only settings that are true or false are offered to set so far; a node-based builder for complex expressions is not built.*
body.title: Moving is a new version of the root
